<LawCallout code="ra9184" section="Section 4 - Scope and Application">
Legal Basis: RA 9184 (Government Procurement Reform Act), as amended by RA 12009 (2024). Governs procurement of consulting services including architectural design for all government entities, GOCCs, and LGUs.
</LawCallout>

blocks.raw: <ExamTip>Three procurement methods for architecture under RA 9184: (1) **Competitive bidding** — standard, open to all qualified; (2) **Limited bidding** — restricted to pre-qualified list, used when few firms have expertise; (3) **Single source procurement** — rare, for emergencies or sole source. Single source for architecture is exceptional.</ExamTip>
